spot.html_text: Both Russell 1919 and Russell 1959 stress the importance of the notion of structure. For instance, in Chapter VI of Russell 1919, it is noticed that two similar relations essentially have the same properties, and hence have the same “structure”. (The notion of “similarity” of relations was introduced in Russell 1901.) We can also use this framework to refine Russell’s discussions on the notion of structure.
